# Halvard Systems Vendor Security Standard (2026 Edition)

Vendor security standard of Halvard Systems, 2026 edition, which supersedes the 2025 edition. Synthetic evaluation material for a fictional company.

## Purpose and Scope

This standard supersedes the 2025 edition in full and applies to every vendor that hosts or processes Halvard Systems systems data from 1 February 2026.

## Encryption Requirement

Vendor systems must encrypt Halvard Systems data in transit and at rest, and keys must be rotated at least annually.

## Incident Notification

A vendor must notify Halvard Systems of a confirmed security incident within twenty-four (24) hours of discovery.

## Access Review

Vendor access to Halvard Systems systems is reviewed quarterly and removed within two business days of a role change.
